articles.title_en: Black Lives: The High Cost of Segregation
articles.title_cn: 黑人的生命：种族隔离的高昂代价
articles.abstract_en: Exploiting the arrangement of railroad tracks in northern cities, we explore the extent to which segregation impacts homicide victimization by race. Our results reveal a robust positive relationship between segregation and non-White homicide victimization. In addition, we find a decrease in public provisions, as highly segregated locations generate fewer revenues and have lower public expenditures. Our findings suggest that White flight and segregation deplete the local tax base, leading to urban decay and higher crime, resulting in the loss of non-White lives. (JEL H71, I32, J15, K42, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用北方城市铁路轨道的布局，我们探讨了种族隔离在多大程度上影响按种族划分的凶杀案受害情况。我们的结果揭示了种族隔离与非白人凶杀案受害之间存在稳健的正相关关系。此外，我们发现公共供给减少，因为高度隔离的地区产生的收入较少，公共支出也较低。我们的研究结果表明，白人逃离和种族隔离耗尽了地方税基，导致城市衰败和犯罪率上升，从而造成非白人生命的损失。(JEL H71, I32, J15, K42, R23)

articles.title_en: Geographic Variation in Mental Health Treatment Utilization: Evidence from Migration
articles.title_cn: 心理健康治疗利用的地理差异：来自迁移的证据
articles.abstract_en: The older population bears a heavy burden of mental illness. Despite the availability of effective treatments, including services (e.g., psychotherapy) and drugs (e.g., antidepressants, antipsychotics), this paper documents substantial geographic variation in treatment utilization rates among Medicare enrollees. Exploiting patient migration, I show that 45.8 percent of service utilization variation is attributable to place-specific factors, compared to 15.1 percent for drug utilization. Further analyses suggest the role of provider accessibility in explaining the different place effects between service and drug use. Regarding health outcomes, I find that higher treatment utilization is associated with lower risks of self-harm-related emergency department visits. (JEL H75, I12, I13, I18)
articles.abstract_cn: 老年人口承受着沉重的精神疾病负担。尽管存在有效的治疗方法，包括服务（如心理治疗）和药物（如抗抑郁药、抗精神病药），本文记录了医疗保险受益人中治疗利用率存在显著的地理差异。利用患者迁移，我表明服务利用差异的45.8%可归因于地点特定因素，而药物利用的这一比例为15.1%。进一步分析表明，提供者可及性在解释服务与药物使用之间不同的地点效应中发挥作用。关于健康结果，我发现较高的治疗利用率与较低的自残相关急诊就诊风险相关。(JEL H75, I12, I13, I18)

articles.title_en: Insecurity and Firm Displacement: Evidence from Afghan Corporate Phone Records
articles.title_cn: 不安全与企业迁移：来自阿富汗企业电话记录的证据
articles.abstract_en: We provide empirical evidence on how insecurity affects firm behavior by linking data on deadly terrorist attacks in Afghanistan to geolocated data on corporate mobile phone activity. We first develop an approach to estimate the geographic footprint of firms based on employee locations. Using these measures, our main analysis shows that violent shocks reduce local firm presence by both increasing firm exit and decreasing entry. Firms respond most strongly to violence in their “headquarters” districts. We also find suggestive evidence of persistence; stronger impacts in more secure districts; and spillovers, whereby attacks in provincial capitals reduce firm presence in surrounding rural districts. (JEL D22, K42, L11, L96, O18, R32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过将阿富汗境内致命恐怖袭击的数据与企业移动电话活动的地理定位数据相关联，提供了关于不安全如何影响企业行为的实证证据。我们首先开发了一种基于员工位置来估计企业地理足迹的方法。利用这些度量，我们的主要分析表明，暴力冲击通过增加企业退出和减少企业进入来减少当地企业的存在。企业对“总部”所在地区的暴力反应最为强烈。我们还发现了持续性的初步证据；在更安全的地区影响更强；以及溢出效应，即省会城市的袭击减少了周边农村地区的企业存在。(JEL D22, K42, L11, L96, O18, R32)

articles.title_en: Are Complementary Policies Substitutes? Evidence from R&D Subsidies in the United Kingdom
articles.title_cn: 互补政策是替代品吗？来自英国研发补贴的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies whether grants and tax incentives for private R&D are complements or substitutes. I use multiple quasi-experimental research designs to examine firms in the United Kingdom and find that increasing tax credit generosity substantially enhances the effect of grant funding on R&D for small firms, suggesting that the instruments are complements. Financial constraints are likely at play. The effects are strongest for firms that appear constrained, and the combination of policies increases R&D “entry.” Furthermore, I find that the instruments are substitutes for larger firms, which are usually less constrained. Some alternative explanations can be ruled out. (JEL D22, H25, H81, L25, O31, O38)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究私人研发的拨款和税收激励是互补品还是替代品。我使用多种准实验研究设计来考察英国的企业，发现增加税收抵免的慷慨程度显著增强了拨款资金对小型企业研发的影响，表明这些工具是互补的。财务约束可能在其中起作用。这些效应在看似受约束的企业中最为显著，且政策组合增加了研发“进入”。此外，我发现这些工具对于通常较少受约束的大型企业而言是替代品。一些替代性解释可以被排除。(JEL D22, H25, H81, L25, O31, O38)

articles.title_en: Sweeping up Gangs: The Effects of Tough-on-Crime Policies from a Network Approach
articles.title_cn: 清扫帮派：基于网络方法的严打犯罪政策效应
articles.abstract_en: Globally, gang proliferation is fought primarily through sweeps. This paper uses a difference-in-differences strategy to examine their causal impact on crime for arrested individuals and their peers. Analysis focuses on the Metropolitan Area of Barcelona, which underwent a notable policy shift. Findings reveal significant crime reductions among those arrested and their peers of 85 percent and 31 percent, respectively. Evidence suggests the first stems from incapacitation and the second from less criminal environment. A counterfactual exercise suggests that broader targeting of key players could have reduced crime by 43 percentage points more. This implies network analysis could enhance policy formulation. (JEL C31, H56, K14, K42, Z18)
articles.abstract_cn: 在全球范围内，打击帮派扩散主要通过清扫行动进行。本文采用双重差分策略，研究这些行动对被逮捕个体及其同伴犯罪行为的因果影响。分析聚焦于巴塞罗那大都会区，该地区经历了显著的政策转变。研究发现，被逮捕者及其同伴的犯罪率分别显著降低了85%和31%。证据表明，前者源于监禁效应，后者源于犯罪环境减少。一项反事实模拟表明，更广泛地针对关键人物本可使犯罪率额外降低43个百分点。这意味着网络分析可以增强政策制定。（JEL C31, H56, K14, K42, Z18）

articles.abstract_en: We estimate that 3.1 percent of US voters, or 6.1 million individuals, were registered to vote in two states in 2020, opening up the possibility for them to choose where to vote. Double registrants are concentrated in the wealthiest zip codes and respond to both incentives and costs, disproportionately choosing to vote in swing states (higher incentive) and states that automatically send out mail-in ballots (lower cost). We call this behavior Cross-State Strategic Voting. While others have documented strategic incentives on who to vote for, this paper is the first to consider strategic incentives on where to vote. (JEL D63, D72, K16)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计，在3.1%年，有6.1的美国选民，即2020万人，在两个州登记投票，这为他们选择在哪里投票提供了可能性。双重登记选民集中在最富裕的邮政编码区域，并对激励和成本均作出反应，不成比例地选择在摇摆州（更高激励）和自动发送邮寄选票的州（更低成本）投票。我们将这种行为称为跨州策略性投票。虽然其他人已经记录了关于投票给谁的策略性激励，但本文是首个考虑在哪里投票的策略性激励的研究。(JEL D63, D72, K16)

articles.title_en: Plata y Plomo: How Higher Wages Expose Politicians to Criminal Violence
articles.title_cn: 金钱与暴力：更高工资如何使政治家暴露于犯罪暴力之中
articles.abstract_en: What is the effect of politicians’ wages on corruption in the presence of criminal groups that use both bribes and violence? With a regression discontinuity design and three distinct proxies for corruption, we show that better-paid Italian politicians are more likely to promote transparency and competition in procurement but also more likely to incur criminal attacks. The effects of wages, which subside after three years, are driven by changes in incumbents’ behavior rather than improved selection. These findings show how higher wages may curb corruption, but also foster the use of violence as an alternative tool to influence policymaking. (JEL D72, D73, J31, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 在存在既使用贿赂又使用暴力的犯罪集团的情况下，政治家工资对腐败的影响是什么？利用断点回归设计以及三种不同的腐败代理指标，我们发现，薪酬更高的意大利政治家更有可能促进采购中的透明度和竞争，但也更有可能遭受犯罪袭击。工资效应在三年后消退，且是由在位者行为变化而非选拔改善所驱动。这些发现表明，更高的工资可能抑制腐败，但也可能促使暴力作为影响政策制定的替代工具被使用。(JEL D72, D73, J31, K42)

articles.title_en: Polling Place Location and the Costs of Voting
articles.title_cn: 投票站位置与投票成本
articles.abstract_en: We study how distance to one’s polling place affects the likelihood of voting using a geographic regression discontinuity design with data from Pennsylvania and Georgia. A one-mile increase in distance to the polling place reduces the likelihood of voting in person by 1 to 3 percentage points. Effects are two to three times higher among those closest to the polling place. When available, voters substitute to mail-in voting as distance to the polling place increases. In counterfactual exercises, we identify turnout-maximizing polling places. Some precincts have large potential gains in turnout, even when choosing from existing buildings. (JEL D72, K16, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用宾夕法尼亚州和佐治亚州的数据，采用地理回归不连续设计，研究到投票站的距离如何影响投票的可能性。到投票站的距离每增加一英里，亲自投票的可能性就会降低1到3个百分点。在距离投票站最近的人群中，这种影响要高出两到三倍。当可以选择时，随着到投票站距离的增加，选民会转向邮寄投票。在反事实模拟中，我们确定了能够最大化投票率的投票站。即使从现有建筑中选择，一些选区的投票率也有很大的潜在提升空间。（JEL D72, K16, R23）

articles.title_en: Hacked to Pieces? The Effects of Ransomware Attacks on Hospitals and Patients
articles.title_cn: 被黑客肢解？勒索软件攻击对医院和患者的影响
articles.abstract_en: As cybercriminals increasingly target health care, hospitals face the growing threat of ransomware attacks. Ransomware is a type of malicious software that prevents users from accessing electronic systems and demands a ransom to restore access. We create and link a database of hospital ransomware attacks to Medicare claims data. We quantify the effects of ransomware attacks on hospital operations and patient outcomes. Ransomware attacks decrease hospital volume by 17–24 percent during the initial attack week, with recovery occurring within 3 weeks. Among patients already admitted to the hospital when a ransomware attack begins, in-hospital mortality increases by 34–38 percent. (JEL D83, I12, I13, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 随着网络犯罪分子日益瞄准医疗保健领域，医院面临日益增长的勒索软件攻击威胁。勒索软件是一种恶意软件，阻止用户访问电子系统并要求支付赎金以恢复访问。我们创建并链接了一个医院勒索软件攻击数据库与医疗保险索赔数据。我们量化了勒索软件攻击对医院运营和患者结果的影响。勒索软件攻击在初始攻击周内使医院就诊量减少17-24%，并在3周内恢复。在勒索软件攻击开始时已住院的患者中，院内死亡率增加了34-38%。（JEL D83, I12, I13, K42）

articles.title_en: Invisible Wounds: How Mental Disability Benefits Shape Veteran Well-Being
articles.title_cn: 无形的创伤：精神残疾补助如何影响退伍军人的福祉
articles.abstract_en: We study impacts of VA disability compensation on the health and well-being of the large and rapidly growing population of veterans claiming mental disorders. We leverage quasi-random assignment of veterans to medical examiners with varying assessing tendencies. An additional $1,000 per year decreases food insecurity and homelessness by 4.1 and 1.3 percent over 5 years. Health care utilization increases, with greater engagement in preventive care. We estimate precise null average effects on health and mortality. Those on the margin of claim denial experience worse outcomes on average than other applicants, with suggestive evidence of large treatment effects for this subpopulation. (JEL I12, I31, I38, J14)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了VA残疾补偿对声称患有精神障碍的退伍军人（这一庞大且快速增长的人群）健康与福祉的影响。我们利用退伍军人被准随机分配到评估倾向各异的医疗检查员这一机制。每年额外增加1,000美元，在4.1年内使食品不安全和无家可归率分别降低1.3%和5。医疗保健利用增加，预防性护理参与度更高。我们估计健康与死亡率上的精确零平均效应。处于索赔被拒边缘的个体平均结果比其他申请者更差，且有提示性证据表明这一亚群体存在较大的处理效应。(JEL I12, I31, I38, J14)

articles.title_en: Connections during Democratic Transitions: Insights from the Political Purge in Post-WWII France
articles.title_cn: 民主转型中的关系网络：二战后法国政治清洗的启示
articles.abstract_en: We examine how connections shaped transitional justice during France’s post-WWII democratic transition. Parliamentarians who had supported the Vichy regime faced a two-stage purge process involving two courts. Using a difference-in-differences strategy, we find that law graduates—an influential group with ties to one of the courts—had a 10 to 14 percentage point higher acquittal rate. We analyze 17,589 documents in individual defendants’ files to explain this difference. According to this analysis, indirect connections—connections through third parties—enabled transmission of information to the judges, highlighting how connected elite groups can navigate transitions despite institutional safeguards. (JEL D72, D83, K41, N44)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在法国二战后民主转型期间，关系网络如何塑造了过渡时期司法。曾支持维希政权的议员面临涉及两个法院的两阶段清洗过程。通过使用双重差分策略，我们发现法律毕业生——一个与其中一个法院有联系的有影响力群体——其无罪释放率高出10至14个百分点。我们分析了个人被告档案中的17,589份文件以解释这一差异。根据这一分析，间接联系——通过第三方建立的联系——使得信息能够传递给法官，突显了尽管存在制度保障，有联系的精英群体如何在转型中游刃有余。（JEL D72, D83, K41, N44）
